description: Get garden objects (plants, buildings, ground shapes). Default: full array. Optionally filter by layer. Pass count_only=true on large scenes to get aggregated counts ({total, byLayer, byType, byProductId}) instead of the array — avoids exceeding the tool-result token budget.

count_only.description: When true, return { total, byLayer, byType, byProductId } instead of the full object array. Honors the layer filter. Recommended for scenes with many objects.

name: get_objects
